architecture: Mission-aware holonomic planner plus latest completed low-level swerve PPO; arm transport interlock
status: In development; existing PPO is a velocity follower, not a trained mission optimizer
hard_constraints: measured arm transport readiness before base motion
fresh cameras, dual IMU, encoders and lidar
comparison_metrics: wheel steering travel and reversal time
visual tracking and object identification success
energy estimate under declared motor model
validation: Compare identical feasible randomized missions and seeds against current fixed-yaw follower. Never call waypoint arrival a successful grasp or claim global optimality from a finite experiment.
upper_level_method_selection: Develop mission-aware holonomic planning/control; compare against fixed-yaw baseline on identical feasible random missions. A separate learned upper policy is optional and requires comparative evidence; low-level PPO remains distinct.
